description: This file defines an Android AppWidgetProvider for a weather widget, including data observation, widget update logic, and handling user interactions.

classes.name: WeatherDataProviderObserver
classes.description: Observes data changes in the content provider and triggers widget update notifications.

classes.name: WeatherWidgetProvider
classes.description: Provides widget functionality including update, refresh, layout building, and user interaction handling.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Called when the observed content data changes; triggers widget data update.

methods.name: onEnabled
methods.description: Initializes the content observer for data changes when widget is enabled.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Handles incoming broadcast intents for widget refresh and user clicks.

methods.name: buildLayout
methods.description: Constructs RemoteViews layout for the widget based on size and layout mode.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Updates all widget instances with current data and layout.

methods.name: onAppWidgetOptionsChanged
methods.description: Adjusts widget layout based on size changes.
